'''Synthcrete''' was a type of material. The hotel [[Solar Wind]], which operated in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], was constructed from synthcrete.
